title: media block, schema 2: pack pictures
description: docs/kernel-schema.md K-R101 (docs/zero-config.md §8). An object keyed by media id (at most 200 items). Nodes list their pictures in node.media, an image view may use one as its frame (views.<id>.media). src is one of three kinds: a relative path under the pack folder ending in .webp / .png / .jpg / .jpeg (shipped and URL packs), a data:image/(webp|png|jpeg);base64 URL (at most 3 MB decoded: pack-media.mjs checks the size, a schema cannot), or an https address with an image file type and no query string (loaded only while the viewer's switch for pictures from links is on, K-R101). Anything else is refused. The viewer re-checks every src against the same patterns before use (K-R64). Private pictures a user keeps in this browser are never part of a pack (K-R102).

anyOf.description: A path under the pack folder (no scheme, no .. segment); after URL resolution it must still lie under the pack's base (K-R64).
An inline picture, at most 3 MB decoded; counted in the document limit (K-R66), exempt from the string cap.
An https address with an image file type and no query string or fragment; loaded only behind the viewer's switch.

credit.description: Who made the picture, shown as text.
